Informed consent for treatment

Please read this in full. You'll need to scroll to the end before you can sign.

Informed Consent for GLP-1 / GIP Weight Management Treatment

This document describes the treatment I am about to receive from NuVi Clinic, including the medication, its risks and benefits, and important information about the specific product used. By signing below, I confirm that I have read and understood this information, that I have had the opportunity to ask questions, and that I voluntarily consent to proceed with treatment.

1. Nature of Treatment

I understand that I am being prescribed tirzepatide, a GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist medication used for weight management and/or metabolic health, administered by weekly subcutaneous injection. I understand that my treatment plan, including dosage, will be determined and adjusted by my treating provider based on my individual response.

2. Risks and Side Effects

I understand that common side effects of GIP/GLP-1 medications may include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, decreased appetite, and injection-site reactions. Less common but more serious risks may include pancreatitis, gallbladder problems, kidney issues, and allergic reactions. I understand that I should contact my provider promptly if I experience severe or persistent symptoms, and seek emergency care for signs of a serious allergic reaction or severe abdominal pain.

3. Compounded Medication — Not FDA-Approved

I understand that the tirzepatide prescribed to me through NuVi Clinic is a compounded product, prepared by a licensed compounding pharmacy, and that:

  • It is not an FDA-approved product (unlike Mounjaro® or Zepbound®, registered trademarks of Eli Lilly).
  • It has not been formally demonstrated to be bioequivalent to the brand-name product in terms of absorption, efficacy, or safety.
  • It is subject to batch-to-batch variability that does not apply to FDA-approved products.
  • Its long-term safety and effectiveness have not been evaluated by the FDA in the same manner as an approved drug product.

4. NuVi Clinic's Scope of Services

I understand that NuVi Clinic does not dispense or prescribe FDA-approved brand-name tirzepatide (Mounjaro®/Zepbound®) as part of its services. I understand that brand-name products may be available to me through other healthcare providers, my health insurance, or the manufacturer's direct-pricing program (LillyDirect®), and that I am free to pursue those options independently if I prefer. I acknowledge this is a general market alternative, not a service offered by NuVi Clinic.

5. Telehealth Care

I understand that my treatment is being provided through telehealth, without an in-person physical examination, and that my treating provider is relying on the information I provide about my health history, current medications, and symptoms. I agree to provide accurate and complete information and to update my provider of any changes in my health status.

6. Voluntary Participation

I understand that my participation in this treatment program is entirely voluntary, that I may stop treatment at any time, and that I may ask questions about my treatment at any point during care.

Acknowledgment

I confirm that I have read this entire document, or had it read to me, and that I understand its contents. I confirm I have had the opportunity to ask questions about the treatment, the compounded medication, and the fact that NuVi Clinic does not offer the brand-name alternative. I voluntarily consent to proceed with the treatment prescribed to me by NuVi Clinic.

About NuVi Clinic

Physician-led metabolic and longevity medicine, built for Puerto Rico.

NuVi Clinic is a telehealth practice offering physician-supervised weight management and longevity care. We were founded on a simple frustration: getting real, well-supervised metabolic care usually means long waits, rushed visits, and pricing nobody can explain.

How we're different

Every prescription is reviewed by a licensed physician. Not a questionnaire, not an algorithm. You complete a health history, then speak with a licensed physician before anything is prescribed. If a medication isn't appropriate for you, we say so.

You see the price before anything ships. Medication is priced by the dose your physician prescribes, and the price for your dose is shown before you pay. Your membership is billed separately and never bundled into a number you can't break down.

Dispensed by a licensed compounding pharmacy. Your prescription is prepared by a licensed 503A compounding pharmacy and shipped directly to you.

Local. We're based in Puerto Rico and currently serve Puerto Rico patients. Expanding to additional jurisdictions requires physician licensure in each one, so we do it deliberately rather than all at once.

Our care team

Medical Director

Physician · Licensed in Puerto Rico

Sets clinical protocols, reviews and approves every prescription, and supervises the care team.

Treating Provider

Physician · Licensed in Puerto Rico

Conducts patient interviews and ongoing care visits under physician supervision.

You'll be introduced to your provider by name when your care begins.

← Back to home

For providers

Working with NuVi Clinic as a clinician or referring provider.

Referring a patient

If you have a patient who would benefit from supervised metabolic or weight management care, you can refer them directly. They'll complete our intake, be interviewed by our care team, and every prescribing decision is made by our supervising physician — we'll keep you informed if your patient asks us to.

Joining our care team

We work with physicians licensed in the jurisdictions we serve. Providers must hold an active, unrestricted license, a current DEA registration where applicable, and an NPI. All prescribing follows documented protocols with physician oversight — we don't operate a rubber-stamp model, and we're not a fit for clinicians looking for one.

Pharmacy and fulfillment

Prescriptions are fulfilled through a licensed 503A compounding pharmacy partner and shipped directly to patients. Ordering is handled by our clinical staff; providers are not asked to manage logistics.

To discuss working together, contact info@nuviclinic.com.

Careers

We're small, early, and building carefully.

NuVi Clinic is in its first year. We're not hiring at volume, and we'd rather be honest about that than post roles we can't fill yet.

Who we're likely to need next

  • Nurse practitioners licensed in Puerto Rico, comfortable with metabolic and weight management care under physician supervision.
  • Patient coordinators — bilingual (Spanish/English), organized, genuinely patient about helping people navigate their care.

If that's you, or you think there's something you could build here that we haven't thought of, we'd rather hear from you early than not at all.

Write to info@nuviclinic.com with a short note about what you'd want to do here.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: August 23, 2026

What we collect

Information you give us: name, date of birth, email address, shipping address, and the health information you provide in your intake and ongoing care (medical conditions, medications, allergies, family history, weight, and related clinical details). Information collected automatically: basic technical data needed to operate the site securely.

How we use it

To provide medical care, to prepare and fulfill prescriptions through our pharmacy partner, to process payments, to communicate with you about your care, and to meet legal and record-keeping obligations. We do not sell your personal or health information.

Who we share it with

Your care team; our licensed compounding pharmacy partner, in order to fill your prescription; our payment processor, for billing; and service providers who help operate the platform under written agreements. We may also disclose information where required by law.

How it's protected

Health information is stored in access-controlled systems with encryption in transit and at rest. Access is limited to the staff who need it to provide your care.

Your choices

You may request access to your records, ask us to correct inaccurate information, and ask questions about how your information is used. Medical records are subject to legal retention requirements, so deletion may not always be possible — we'll tell you plainly if that applies.

Questions: info@nuviclinic.com.

Terms of Service

Last updated: August 23, 2026

What NuVi Clinic is

NuVi Clinic provides telehealth medical services through licensed providers. Using this site does not by itself create a provider-patient relationship — that begins only after you complete an intake and are evaluated by our care team.

Not for emergencies

This service is not for medical emergencies. If you are experiencing a medical emergency, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room.

Eligibility

You must be 18 or older and physically located in a jurisdiction where our providers are licensed. You agree to give accurate and complete health information — our providers rely on it to make safe decisions about your care.

Your responsibility for the information you give us

Our providers make clinical decisions based on what you tell us. You agree that the health information you provide — including conditions, medications, allergies, surgical history, substance use, and family history — is true, accurate, and complete, and that you have not withheld anything relevant. You agree to promptly update us if anything changes.

Withholding or misstating health information can lead to a prescribing decision that would not otherwise have been made, and can cause serious harm. To the fullest extent permitted by law, NuVi Clinic is not responsible for adverse outcomes that result from information you failed to disclose or misrepresented.

No guarantee of treatment

Completing an intake or paying a membership fee does not guarantee you will be prescribed any medication. If our provider determines a treatment isn't clinically appropriate for you, it will not be prescribed.

Membership, billing, and cancellation

Membership is $50 per month, billed monthly. Medication is billed separately based on what your physician prescribes. There is no minimum commitment. You can cancel at any time from Settings, and cancelling stops all future charges. The month already paid is not prorated — your access runs to the end of the period you paid for.

Compounded medication is prepared individually for you and cannot be returned or reused, so medication charges are non-refundable once the prescription has been transmitted to the pharmacy. If a physician declines to treat you, your membership payment is refunded in full. Full details are in our Refund Policy.

Compounded medications

Some medications we prescribe are compounded by a licensed 503A compounding pharmacy operating under state and federal quality regulations. Each preparation is made individually against your physician's prescription.

Questions: info@nuviclinic.com.

Notice of Privacy Practices

Effective date: August 23, 2026

THIS NOTICE DESCRIBES HOW MEDICAL INFORMATION ABOUT YOU MAY BE USED AND DISCLOSED AND HOW YOU CAN GET ACCESS TO THIS INFORMATION. PLEASE REVIEW IT CAREFULLY.

Our commitment

NuVi Clinic is required by law to maintain the privacy of your protected health information (PHI), to give you this notice of our legal duties and privacy practices, and to follow the terms of the notice currently in effect. We are also required to notify you if a breach of your unsecured PHI occurs.

How we may use and disclose your health information without your authorization

Treatment. To provide, coordinate, and manage your care. For example, we share your prescription and relevant history with our compounding pharmacy partner so your medication can be prepared and shipped, and among our own providers so they can make safe clinical decisions.

Payment. To bill and collect payment for services. For example, we process your membership and medication charges through our payment processor. We do not send clinical details to our payment processor.

Health care operations. To run the practice — including quality review, evaluating provider performance, training, and business management.

As required by law. When federal, state, or Puerto Rico law requires it.

Public health and safety. To prevent or reduce a serious threat to health or safety; to report suspected abuse, neglect, or domestic violence; to report adverse events or product problems to the FDA; and for public health activities such as disease reporting.

Health oversight, judicial, and law enforcement. To health oversight agencies for audits and investigations; in response to a court order, subpoena, or other lawful process; and to law enforcement in the limited circumstances the law allows.

Others involved in your care. If you agree, or if you are not present and we judge it to be in your best interest, we may share information relevant to your care with a family member or friend involved in it.

Uses and disclosures that always require your written authorization

  • Most uses and disclosures of psychotherapy notes.
  • Uses and disclosures for marketing purposes.
  • Any sale of your protected health information.
  • Most other uses and disclosures not described in this notice.

If you give us written authorization, you may revoke it at any time in writing. Revoking it will not affect disclosures we already made while it was in effect.

Your rights

Get a copy of your record. You can ask to see or get an electronic or paper copy of your medical record. We will provide it within 30 days, and may charge a reasonable, cost-based fee.

Ask us to correct your record. You can ask us to correct information you believe is incorrect or incomplete. We may say no, but we will tell you why in writing within 60 days.

Request confidential communications. You can ask us to contact you in a specific way, or at a different address. We will say yes to all reasonable requests.

Ask us to limit what we use or share. You can ask us not to use or share certain information. We are not required to agree, and may say no if it would affect your care. However: if you pay for a service in full out of pocket and ask us not to share that information with your health insurer, we must agree unless a law requires us to share it.

Get a list of disclosures. You can request an accounting of certain disclosures we made in the six years before your request.

Get a copy of this notice. You can ask for a paper copy at any time, even if you agreed to receive it electronically.

Choose someone to act for you. If you have given someone medical power of attorney or they are your legal guardian, that person can exercise these rights on your behalf.

File a complaint. If you believe your privacy rights have been violated, you can file a complaint with us using the contact details below, or with the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services Office for Civil Rights at 200 Independence Avenue SW, Washington DC 20201; 1-877-696-6775; or hhs.gov/hipaa/filing-a-complaint. We will not retaliate against you for filing a complaint.

Changes to this notice

We can change the terms of this notice, and the changes will apply to all information we hold about you. The current notice will always be posted on this page with its effective date.

Refund Policy

Last updated: August 25, 2026

We bill two separate things, and they work differently. Your membership pays for clinical care. Medication is billed on its own, only when a physician prescribes it. This page explains what happens to each one if you want your money back.

Membership

Membership is $50 per month and is billed monthly to the card you used at signup. There is no minimum commitment.

You can cancel at any time from Settings in your patient dashboard. Cancelling stops all future charges immediately. The month already paid for is not prorated or refunded — your access continues until the end of the period you paid for.

Medication

Compounded medication is prepared individually for you, against your physician's prescription, in the dose that physician selected. It cannot be returned, restocked, or dispensed to anyone else, and the law does not permit a pharmacy to accept it back.

For that reason, medication charges are non-refundable once your prescription has been transmitted to the pharmacy. If you paid but your prescription has not yet been sent, we refund the medication charge in full — contact us and we will confirm the status before anything is dispensed.

If a physician declines to treat you

Paying for a membership does not guarantee you will be prescribed anything. If our physician evaluates you and determines that treatment is not clinically appropriate, we refund your membership payment in full and you are not charged for medication. This applies whether the decision is made at your first evaluation or a later one.

Duplicate and incorrect charges

If you were charged twice for the same thing, charged after cancelling, or charged an amount that does not match what you were quoted, tell us and we will refund the difference in full. We do not treat billing errors as final.

How to request a refund

Email info@nuviclinic.com from the address on your account and tell us which charge you are asking about. We respond within two business days and, when a refund is due, issue it to the original payment method. Refunds usually appear within five to ten business days depending on your bank.

If something looks wrong with a charge, please contact us before disputing it with your bank. We can almost always resolve it faster than a dispute can, and we would rather fix it than argue about it.

Questions about billing: info@nuviclinic.com.

    Patient safety

    Reporting a side effect or bad reaction

    If this is an emergency, stop and call 911. Trouble breathing, swelling of the face or throat, severe abdominal pain, or fainting need emergency care now — not a message to us.

    For anything that is not an emergency, tell us. We want to hear about it even if you are not sure it is related to your medication.

    How to reach us
    • Message your care team from your dashboard — this reaches a clinician and becomes part of your record.
    • Call (787) 299-8643
    • Email info@nuviclinic.com
    What we do with it

    A clinician reviews every report, we record it in your chart, and we contact you to decide whether to adjust your dose, pause treatment, or send you to be seen in person. Serious or unexpected reactions are reported onward to the compounding pharmacy and, where appropriate, to the FDA.

    You can also report it directly to the FDA

    This is independent of us and you do not need our permission: FDA MedWatch, or call 1-800-FDA-1088.
